title: Title of the CR (from Redmine)
notes: Copy this folder to tests/cr-suites/<CR number>/ (folder name without the leading underscore), fill the scenarios, then: npm run suites:gen. Folders starting with _ are not generated. Fields: flow = a registry flow (npm run qa -- list-flows); prepare.until = the step ID or status where data prep stops (omit: the execution starts from scratch); execute.until = where the execution ends (omit execute: the tester executes by hand on the prepared data); expected = the approved expected result (never invent it); manual = how to execute by hand.
